title: Protein Aggregation Capture and Automated Processing for Proteomics
author: ronan o'cualain

If you have a half plate of 96 samples, enter "6". The method will need to be modified if more samples on the plate are to be processed. steps.title: Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads using ultrapure water and a magnetic stand.

substeps.instruction: Briefly vortex the beads and place the tube on a magnetic stand for 00:02:00 to collect the beads.
Add ultrapure water at a volume corresponding to 5 to 10 times the initial volume of mixed beads.
Vortex the beads for 00:00:10 and place on a magnetic stand for 00:02:00 to collect the beads.
Carefully aspirate and discard the wash buffer with a gel loading tip.
Repeat the wash steps a further two times.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the washed beads for use or storage.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads with ultrapure water at a final concentration of 20 µg/µL.
Optional: Store washed beads at 4 °C for up to one month.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Binding
steps.instruction: Add washed beads to samples and verify pH levels.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of washed beads to samples in HEPES pH 7.5 in an Eppendorf 96 well / 500uL plate (ratio of 5-10 µg of beads to 1 µg of protein).
Measure an aliquot on pH paper to ensure the sample pH is in the range of pH 7.0 to pH 8.5 for optimal binding.

steps.title: Configure Automated Liquid Handler
steps.instruction: Set up the NxP workstation and load the required method.

substeps.instruction: Under the Method tab, select 'home all axes' to orient the automated liquid handler.
Under File, select Open/Method and select the 'PACmethodV01' method.
Add four p1000 tip boxes to the deck of the NxP.
Add one Beckman full reservoir containing 150 mL of 100% volume acetonitrile.
Add one Beckman full reservoir containing 150 mL of 70% volume acetonitrile.

steps.title: Initiate Automated Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample plate and run the automated method.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 100% volume acetonitrile to each sample in the Eppendorf 96 well 500uL plate containing Resyn beads.
Mix briefly on a plate shaker, then place the plate on the Biomek instrument.
Start the method by clicking the green Run icon.

steps.title: Maintain Workstation During Run
steps.instruction: Monitor the workstation and replenish supplies as prompted.

substeps.instruction: When the workstation pauses after acetonitrile washing steps, replenish used tips and refill reservoirs if needed.
Do not reach into the workstation while the program is running to avoid breaking the 'light curtain' safety precaution.

steps.title: Recover Eluates
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and elute proteins from the beads.

substeps.instruction: After digestion, remove the supernatant, leaving the beads behind (via modified transfer file method or manually using a gel loading tip).
Add 100 µL of 0.1% volume formic acid to the beads.
Place the plate on a plate shaker for 00:02:00.
Remove supernatant and pool eluates.
